title: Cross-sectional 12-month currency momentum across seven FX majors, long top 1, short bottom 1, monthly
source: Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013), Value and Momentum Everywhere, Journal of Finance 68(3)
why: Paper ranks each asset class by its past 12-month return and goes long the top third, short the bottom third (currencies, 1979-2011, P3-P1 Sharpe 0.34). This spec takes the one-basket version on seven liquid majors, using the paper's 12-month lookback with a 21-day monthly hold. Deviation: the paper skips the most recent month (12-1); the engine has no skip, so the lookback is the plain 252-day return. Top 1 of 7 is a narrower cut than the paper's terciles.
